tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List VaultRubric's public categories (crypto exchanges, hardware/software wallets, high-yield savings, brokerages) with platform counts and data URLs.

tools.name: search_platforms
tools.description: Search tracked platforms by name and/or category; returns VaultRubric score, data coverage and pick eligibility.

tools.name: get_platform
tools.description: Full sourced record for one platform: per-criterion scores with basis and source URLs, incidents, regulatory actions, as-of dates, and related page URLs.

tools.name: compare_platforms
tools.description: Compare 2-6 platforms in one category with optional criterion weights. Applies VaultRubric's 75% coverage gate, 60% hack cap and too-close-to-call (<3 points) rules.

tools.name: get_verdict
tools.description: Get the published verdict (direct answer, key facts, as-of date, URL) for a VaultRubric comparison page.

tools.name: check_platform_safety
tools.description: Safety record for a platform: customer-funds hacks, incidents, regulatory actions and security score, with sources and the safety page URL.

tools.name: calculate_savings_interest
tools.description: Project interest on a balance over N months at every high-yield savings account VaultRubric tracks, using sourced standard APYs (promos shown separately), minimum balances and monthly fees. Estimates, not advice.

tools.name: estimate_fees
tools.description: Estimate annual cost at every brokerage or crypto exchange VaultRubric tracks from sourced fees (commissions, options per-contract, transfer-out; exchange taker fees). Unknown fees are flagged, never assumed.

tools.name: get_market_movers
tools.description: Top crypto (24h, CoinGecko) or US stock (delayed, Yahoo/Nasdaq) gainers and losers, each with the latest sourced headline that names it. News and data only, not advice.

tools.name: get_ipo_calendar
tools.description: Upcoming and recently priced IPOs (Nasdaq IPO calendar) with price ranges, exchanges and first-day results, plus the latest SEC EDGAR S-1/F-1 filings.

tools.name: get_asset_news
tools.description: Delayed price and latest headlines (Google News, with source URLs) for a stock ticker or a top-250 crypto asset. Headlines are quoted as reported; no predictions.
